name: nuvemshop-dev-frontend
description: Build de CSS (Tailwind) e JS (esbuild + Alpine) para o tema Nuvemshop

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run inject
scripts.dev: node build.mjs --watch & node inject.mjs --watch & tailwindcss -i src/css/main.css -o ../theme/static/css/tailwind.css --watch
